digest.component_or_area: rebar codebase refactoring / defect review consolidation epic
propositions: Duplicated decision logic appears in 2-7 places across the codebase, causing fixes to land incompletely and defects to arrive in multi-ticket families
Each consolidation child must collapse one duplicated computation into a single shared module while preserving pinned observable behavior verified by existing tests
Construct-uniqueness guards must assert exactly one implementation exists per consolidated construct using AST matching and conjunctions of distinctive atoms, with mandatory escape markers
Acceptance criterion AC3 (net-negative line count across consolidation children) is failing because extracted owners require documented rationale that increases line count despite call-site shrinkage
Acceptance criterion AC2 ('additions only' in tests/) conflicts with consolidation's inherent need to delete duplicated test helpers and re-point references to the unified owner module
